goal: LSPosed module hooking ConsumerIrService (HIDL bridge for IR blaster) and system-app install gates (unknown sources, same version, downgrade, reboot scan) for TECNO KL5 Android 17 GSI
decisions_made: App display name: KL5 IR & SysApp
Adaptive icon: custom hardware IR diode + shield artwork generated into mdpi/hdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi layers via tools/make_adaptive_icon.py
Confirmed repo-level signing secrets KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD exist in vjumbo264/forgebuild
Hooking mechanism: LSPosed Xposed API (compileOnly de.robv.android.xposed:api:82 via https://api.xposed.info/) scoping system_server / android

SysApp strategy: Scoped hooks on PackageInstallerSession.validateApkInstallLocked, InstallPackageHelper.preparePackage, InstallPackageHelper.verifyReplacingVersionCode, and PackageManagerService boot scan logic targeting only system-flagged packages

IR strategy: Real frozen android.hardware.ir@1.0::IConsumerIr HIDL interface utilized; dual-mode implementation with full C++ JNI source (motionsalt_ir_bridge.cpp, Android.bp, Android.mk) and in-process Java HwBinder IPC (HidlIrBridge.kt) ensuring native and non-NDK runtime execution

Honesty disclosure: Native JNI source provided and verified against frozen HIDL 1.0 specifications; since cloud CI runner does not bundle AOSP platform HIDL client libraries (libhidlbase/android.hardware.ir@1.0), the runtime uses Java HwBinder IPC directly within system_server, avoiding fabricated binaries
Companion UI: Material 3 Expressive UI displaying live LSPosed hook status, install gate architecture, IR bridge parameters, and copyable on-device testing commands
